_comment: The reference measurement the parse-rate gate is judged against. The full run log is NOT committed (experiments/*/results/ is gitignored); this is its distilled result + provenance. Regenerate with scripts/measure-parse-rate.sh and update deliberately.

provenance.commit_note: squashed into 41af6db (main); kernel/, ontologies/, crates/*/src are byte-identical between them
provenance.reranker_note: this run PREDATES the temperature:0 pin — it sampled at temperature 1.0

gates.coverage: grammar_gap == 0 and missing_lexeme == 0 — every sentence parses
gates.faithfulness: encoded should RISE; it is the open goal (1/62 today)

reproduced.note: temperature:0 pinned. THREE consecutive runs, all grammar-gap 0.

reproducibility.finding: temperature:0 is NOT deterministic. Two live runs of identical code against an identical store differed on 21% of full sense orders and 5% of the CAPPED top-2 — and the capped top-2 is the only part that reaches the parser. The outcome was nonetheless stable (3/3 grammar-gap 0), so the pin shrinks the variance below the threshold that changes the verdict, but it does NOT make a run reproducible.
reproducibility.the_only_exact_reproduction: scripts/measure-parse-rate.sh --replay <run>/ranks.json — replays the recorded rankings with no LLM at all. A replay with misses > 0 is a different experiment, not a reproduction.
reproducibility.before_the_pin: at the API default (temperature 1.0) the drift was large enough to drop correct senses before parsing, producing 12 phantom grammar gaps on 2026-07-11.
